description: Use when you need to PREPARE a compliant French e-invoice for a company (invoice header, VAT number, addressing) rather than decide whether paying it is safe; for the full verify-the-supplier-before-payment verdict, IBAN included, call prepare_french_invoice_file. The French e-invoicing mandate applies from 1 September 2026: receiving becomes obligatory for every VAT-liable company on that date, issuing is phased (large and mid-sized companies 1 September 2026, SMEs and micro-enterprises 1 September 2027; art. 91 of the 2024 Finance Act). Returns legal name & form, active/ceased status, computed intra-EU VAT number (+ VIES-check pointer), establishments (SIRET) with addresses, NAF code (with its nomenclature, NAF 2025 code and status) and indicative send/receive obligation dates from the INSEE size category. The response is Ed25519-signed and carries provenance[] (one entry per block served, with the official register, its licence and its as_of date), so the preparation is auditable offline. Preparation only: Sirenic is not an accredited platform (PDP), does not access the central directory and never issues, transmits or routes invoices, nor confirms PPF/PDP registration. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a unit not proven to be a legal person has destinataire.denomination null, uncounted; destinataire.information states the partial diffusion. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN of the company to be invoiced (digits only, no spaces); use search_french_companies first if you only have a name

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
